data.one_liner: Flutter integration for MobX, providing reactive Observer widgets.
data.what_it_does: Integrates MobX state management into Flutter by providing an Observer widget that listens to observables and automatically rebuilds widgets when tracked properties change.
use_when: You use MobX for state management in your Dart or Flutter application
You want automatic UI rebuilding when observables change without manual subscription management
avoid_when: You prefer other state management solutions like Riverpod or BLoC
You do not want to use MobX observables in your project
strengths: Automatic tracking of observables inside the Observer widget
Seamless reactive programming model for Flutter
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the MobX ecosystem
Requires proper structuring of observables to avoid unnecessary rebuilds
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_mobx, mobx, and provider to your dependencies.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust, compile-safe alternative for state management and dependency injection.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses a predictable events-to-states architecture with clear separation of concerns.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a simpler inherited-widget-based dependency injection and state management approach.
